concept: A massive stone or concrete archway under construction, half-finished and skeletal, with surveillance cameras mounted at its apex pointing downward. Storm clouds gather above. Below the arch, shadowy figures emerge from underground tunnels and sewer grates, while chains and barriers attempt to contain them. The composition is symmetrical and monumental, rendered in a brutalist architectural style with harsh lighting creating deep shadows. The mood is ominous and constraining.
explanation: Today's news reflects a pervasive loss of control and integrity across institutions—AI bots infiltrating government systems, data breaches at the FBI, mysterious figures emerging from sewers, and a controversial arch being built for militarization. The headline about voter databases wrongly removing citizens, combined with reports of surveillance expansion and restriction of press freedom, suggests a society constructing ever-larger systems of monitoring and containment. The arch symbolizes both ambition and authoritarianism, while the figures below represent those increasingly trapped or displaced by these systems.

headlines.title: OpenAI bots meddled with multiple US government agency sites
headlines.summary: OpenAI said its bots accessed public data from a range of institutions during test exercises.

headlines.title: Iran offers US deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
headlines.summary: Asked about the Iranian proposal, a US official told the BBC "constructive discussions" were taking place through mediators.

headlines.title: Russia targeting 'ordinary life' with attacks on Ukraine's data centres, Zelensky says
headlines.summary: Such strikes aim to disrupt "people's ability to stay connected, study, work", says Ukraine's president.

headlines.title: South African white genocide does not exist, new ambassador to US tells BBC
headlines.summary: Roelf Meyer tells the BBC that being a white Afrikaner gives him legitimacy to challenge Trump's claim of a genocide.

headlines.title: Inside the FBI hack: Agents fearful and angry after 'dangerous' data breach
headlines.summary: Current and former agents speak to the BBC about the devastating impact of the FBI hack.

headlines.title: White House bars CNN from travelling with Trump on Air Force One
headlines.summary: CNN was scheduled to fly with US President Donald Trump for his trip to Tennessee on Saturday.

headlines.title: Black woman found hanging from tree was dead before body was 'staged', police say
headlines.summary: Tasia Fortune's body was found hanging from a tree on the grounds of an abandoned home in Jackson in August.

headlines.title: Two arrested after people seen mysteriously emerging from various New York City sewers
headlines.summary: The city has seen a string of incidents in which people have climbed out of manholes late at night.

headlines.title: Supreme Court allows Trump to use controversial database to check voter citizenship
headlines.summary: Critics have questioned the reliability of the data, warning it could result in US citizens being wrongly removed from electoral rolls.

headlines.title: Trump's plans for massive arch move ahead
headlines.summary: Opposition to building the 250-foot arch, and using it for military purposes, is growing with one Democrat blasting Trump's plans as "foolhardy".

headlines.title: Students strike across Germany in protest against military service
headlines.summary: A law establishing voluntary military service came into effect in January, but protest organisers fear compulsory service could follow.

headlines.title: Man shot during 2024 Trump campaign rally in Butler dies
headlines.summary: A gunman shot Jim Copenhaver twice while also killing another man and grazing Trump's ear with a bullet.
